title: Timony
label: CROSSOVER
why: #1 on Beatport's Psy-Trance Top 100 (4 Oct 2026), released 25 Sep 2026 on CROSSOVER. Omiki and Faders are two of the hottest names in modern full-on/psy-techno — the current peak-time number one.

title: Om
label: Nano Records
why: #2 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Nano Records, Sept 2026. Avalon is a festival-headline staple; Om is a mantra-themed full-on roller for the peak.

title: Aria
label: NEWORLD
why: #3 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026). Omiki's psy rework of Argy & Omnya's Afterlife anthem Aria — the vocal hook techno crowds already know, now over a rolling psy bass. Perfect bridge from melodic techno into psy.
notes: Official upload is a short edit (3:00; Beatport length 4:37). Unofficial full-length: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=esGOK5fNNYw (carmatic, 4:39)

title: Horizons
label: MAGIC MOMENTS RECORDS
why: #4 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Magic Moments Records, 2025. Phaxe's remix turns Horizons into a 9-minute progressive-psy journey: tight rolling bass, long builds, euphoric lead — a reliable set-builder.

artist: Tristan, Burn In Noise, Avalon, Altruism
title: The God Molecule
label: Nano Records
yt_title: Tristan, Avalon, Burn in Noise & Altruism - The God Molecule
why: #5 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Nano Records 2026. A supergroup of Tristan, Avalon, Burn In Noise and Altruism — veteran full-on power with modern production; trippy leads, relentless groove.

title: A Prayer for the Dancefloor
label: KNTXT
yt_title: Charlotte de Witte feat. Conduit - A Prayer for the Dancefloor (Avalon & GMS Remix)
why: #7 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), KNTXT 2026. Avalon & GMS re-cut Charlotte de Witte's techno track as psy on her own label — the techno/psy crossover in action; ideal for techno-leaning crowds.

title: Free My Soul
label: Armada Music
why: #8 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Armada Music, Aug 2026. Vini Vici & Space 92 with CERES on vocals: mainstage psy-techno with a singalong hook. Extended mix for clean mixing.

title: Wana
label: CROSSOVER
why: #18 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), CROSSOVER, Jan 2026. Brazilian full-on hitter Vegas teams with Omiki: tribal percussion over a pumping bassline — still charting nine months after release.

title: Incoming Signal
label: Mutant Disco Records
yt_title: Ace Ventura, Ritmo & Volcano - Incoming Signal
why: #19 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Mutant Disco Records, released 2 Oct 2026. Ace Ventura and Ritmo are progressive-psy royalty; hypnotic, groovy, rolling — the sort of track that works at Boom sunset or a club peak.

title: Surface
label: Spin Twist Records
why: #24 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Spin Twist Records (Neelix's label), Sept 2026. Neelix's trademark melodic, catchy progressive psy — compact 4-minute arrangement, easy to drop in.
notes: Official audio runs 4:04, matching the Beatport original mix length (4:03).

title: I Believe in Dragons
label: Iboga Records
yt_title: Liquid Soul - I Believe in Dragons
why: #25 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Iboga Records, Aug 2026. Liquid Soul (Swiss producer, Iboga mainstay) does what he does best: big, bright, euphoric progressive-psy with a singable lead.

artist: Ace Ventura, Astrix, Volcano On Mars
title: Pranava
label: Mutant Disco Records
yt_title: Ace Ventura & Astrix - Pranava (Volcano on Mars Remix)
why: #30 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Mutant Disco Records 2026. Two legends — Ace Ventura & Astrix — remixed by Volcano On Mars into a deep, rolling, meditative banger.

title: Na Le
label: Spin Twist Records
why: #31 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026) despite a 2021 release on Spin Twist — five years of chart life. Phaxe's remix of Omiki's Na Le: ethnic vocal sample, punchy kick-bass, pure dancefloor joy.

title: Viento
label: ARTCORE RECORDS
why: #35 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), ARTCORE Records, Dec 2024. Funk Tribu's Viento is a psy-techno roller that's been on the chart for nearly two years — tough, minimal, techno-friendly.

title: Universo
label: Shamanic Tales
why: #41 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Shamanic Tales 2020. Astrix & Rising Dust: a 10-minute modern full-on epic with layered acid and big breakdowns — still charting six years on.

title: Deep Jungle Walk
why: #42 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026). Astrix's signature anthem from the HOMmega era, now in the Shamanic Tales catalogue — tribal drums, dense acid and that famous jungle atmosphere; one of the most-played psy tracks ever.

title: Mystical Experiences
label: Dacru Records
why: #50 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Dacru Records, Aug 2026. Full-on veterans GMS remix Electric Universe — high-energy full-on with classic Goa colours.

title: Rebirth
label: Mutant Disco Records
why: #69 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Mutant Disco Records 2026. Faders & Blazy give Ace Ventura's Rebirth a sharper, harder edge — modern progressive-psy power for the peak.

title: Music Is The Answer
label: Alteza Records
yt_title: Vini Vici & Tristan & Avalon - Music Is The Answer (Extended Mix) | Alteza Records
why: #71 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Alteza Records 2025. Vini Vici, Tristan and Avalon — three generations of psy headliners — on a feel-good, vocal-driven 'music is the answer' peak-time track.

title: Free Tibet
label: Iboga Records
yt_title: Hilight Tribe - Free Tibet (Vini Vici Remix)
why: #73 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026) — a decade after its 2016 Iboga release. The remix that made Vini Vici superstars; Hilight Tribe's live-band chant turned into a psy anthem played everywhere from Ozora to Tomorrowland.

title: Frequency Brotherhood
label: Dacru Records
yt_title: Talamasca & DJ Dot & Originals - Frequency Brotherhood
why: #77 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Dacru Records, Sept 2026. French full-on veteran Talamasca with DJ Dot and Originals — old-school Goa leads and modern punch.

title: Dunes
label: Shamanic Tales
why: #87 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Shamanic Tales 2024. Ritmo & Asgard's Dunes — desert-themed progressive psy that Ritmo played at Ozora 2023; hypnotic and groovy, two years in the chart.

title: High Street
label: KNTXT
yt_title: Charlotte de Witte - High Street (Astrix Remix) [RPMX004]
why: #88 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), KNTXT 2023. Astrix's remix of Charlotte de Witte's High Street — a key record of the techno-psy crossover; dark, driving and huge.

title: Sahara
label: Future Music Records
why: #90 on Beatport Psy-Trance Top 100 (Oct 2026), Future Music Records 2018. Astrix's Sahara — an eastern-flavoured full-on anthem that still sits in the chart eight years after release.

title: Becoming Insane
why: Curated classic, 2007 (Vicious Delicious album). Infected Mushroom's most famous track: guitar riffs, vocal madness and full-on fury — a crowd-recognised anthem that defined 2000s psy.

title: Adhana
label: Iboga Records
why: Curated: Vini Vici & Astrix, Iboga Records 2017. Adhana's chanted vocal and soaring lead made it one of the biggest psy tracks of the late 2010s; huge at festivals around the world.

artist: Armin van Buuren, Vini Vici, Hilight Tribe

label: Armind
yt_title: Armin van Buuren vs Vini Vici feat. Hilight Tribe - Great Spirit (Extended Mix)
why: Curated: Armin van Buuren vs Vini Vici feat. Hilight Tribe, Armind 2016. The track that took psytrance to EDM mainstages — tribal chant, massive drop; unbeatable for big-room peak moments.

title: The Tribe
why: Curated: Vini Vici's The Tribe — an early Vini Vici anthem with tribal chant and pounding full-on bass, from the run that made them headliners.

title: LSD
label: Twisted Records
why: Curated Goa classic: Hallucinogen (Simon Posford) — LSD, mid-90s, now in the Twisted Records catalogue. Squelchy acid and spiralling leads made it the defining Goa/psy anthem; still devastating on a big rig.

title: Gamma Goblins
why: Curated Goa classic: Hallucinogen's Gamma Goblins — Posford's 90s twisted-acid masterpiece, remixed many times since (Outsiders & Space Cat, Soundaholix). The original still rips.

title: Mahadeva
label: Trust In Trance
why: Curated Goa classic: Astral Projection's Mahadeva on Trust In Trance — the 90s Israeli Goa anthem with soaring leads; still remixed and played at Boom and Ozora.

title: Navras
label: Metropolis Records
why: Curated: Juno Reactor's Navras — the closing theme of The Matrix Revolutions (2003), Sanskrit chant and orchestra over a driving psy groove. Epic, cinematic peak-time moment.

title: Pistolero
why: Curated: Astrix's remix of Juno Reactor's Pistolero — flamenco guitar meets full-on psy; a festival favourite that turns any crowd.

title: Liquid Hook
label: Iboga Records
yt_title: Captain Hook & Liquid Soul - Liquid Hook
why: Curated progressive-psy classic: Liquid Soul & Captain Hook, Iboga 2011. Liquid Hook is a big, rolling, euphoric anthem from Iboga's golden era; remixed again in 2026, which tells you it still works.

title: Six Feet Under
label: Iboga Records
yt_title: Perfect Stranger - Six Feet Under (Captain Hook Remix)
why: Curated: Perfect Stranger's Six Feet Under remixed by Captain Hook, Iboga 2018 — dark, groovy, progressive-psy masterclass from one of Israel's most reliable producers.

title: Psychedelic Trance
label: Dacru Records
why: Curated: Talamasca's Psychedelic Trance (Dacru Records) — the title says it all; classic French full-on with a hands-up lead built for the peak.

title: Hit 'N' Run
why: Curated: Skazi's Hit 'N' Run — Asher Swissa's rock-psy anthem, electric guitar riffs and aggressive full-on; a crowd eruption track.

label: KNTXT

why: Curated: Avalon & GMS, KNTXT 2025 (Charlotte de Witte's techno label). Rave To The Grave is the techno-psy crossover done right — perfect for Robin's techno-leaning sets.

title: Bang Bang
label: Spin Twist Records
yt_title: Neelix - Bang Bang (Extended Mix - Official Audio)
why: Curated: Neelix, Spin Twist Records 2019. Bang Bang — catchy, melodic progressive psy from the German producer, one of the most-streamed names in psy.

title: Mysterious Ways
label: Nutek Records
why: Curated: Sesto Sento, Nutek Records 2008. Mysterious Ways was one of the biggest full-on anthems of the late 2000s; Avan7 remixed it again in 2026.

title: Ingonyama
label: Iboga Records
yt_title: Ace Ventura & Juno Reactor - Ingonyama (BLiSS remix)
why: Curated: Ace Ventura & Juno Reactor's Ingonyama, BLiSS remix, Iboga 2019 — Zulu vocals over a pounding progressive-psy groove; a Boom Festival 2018 highlight.

label: Blue Tunes Records

title: Mandala

title: Conquistador
label: Shamanic Tales
